platform: WordPress + WooCommerce (classic theme gadgetim, plugin gadgetim-core)
upload: Claude publishes through the shop owner's signed-in dashboard in Chrome (REST with the cookie nonce); the owner signs in at /eesa

currency.shown_in: IRT (Toman), materialised by gadgetim-core from the AED base price

default_stock: in stock without quantity management, unless the product's text file gives a quantity
shipping: Tipax, Dakapost, Post Pishtaz; pay on delivery (پس‌کرایه), no free shipping
warranty: authenticity guarantee and 7-day condition check (گارانتی اصالت کالا و تست سلامت ۷ روزه)

image_format.branding: bottom band: logo + favicon on one side, support phone on the other; very faint GADGETIM in the middle. Composited locally, not by Gemini (it garbles text and digits)

input_layout: mahsolat/<name>/<name>/ folders (not zips): images, 1.* is the featured image, one .txt
